verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a dedicated webhooks integration guide with real-time HTTP notifications for card transaction events (approved, declined, settled, failed), plus HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Its Instant Pay page also advertises real-time webhooks. Missing for 10: documentation of how endpoints are registered or subscriptions managed, an event catalog beyond card transactions, retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
